title: Outerworlds
description: An exploration focused modpack with dungeons, structures and more than 100+ biomes while having stunning visuals and good performance!
body:
# ![Outerworlds v1.2.0 - The Lively Update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63587b5eaedbf5bc0d55e59f1de812957d1d08e1.png)

A modpack designed for players seeking

extreme levels of exploration and a relaxing experience

![Outerworlds v1.1.0 - Screenshot #1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3da86596f4a1eb6b109acb00fa4c68adf17cc77a.jpeg)

Looting is essencial and exploration is obrigatory.

Look around and decide where are you going.

In this vast world, you decide your fate, so get going and begin your journey. # Features 🎭 [Updated!] - ![Minecraft Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a046afca15d041643d46088be5b1f0ae9ca1a4c_0.webp) Just like **Vanilla Minecraft but better!** - 🌍 An Overworld with more than **100+ biomes** to explore! - 🏃‍♀️‍➡️ **Better animations** providing a more satisfying experience! - ✨ Feel the world **alive** with better **Visual Effects** - 🔊 **Immersive** experience with new **Sound Effects** - 📷 An overhaul on the Third Person View, providing a **different way to play**. - 🎮 **Controller friendly**! - 🖼️ **Smooth framerate** while still having **good visuals** (and runs on potato Pcs). - ⚔️ A Simplified Combat system providing **enjoyable fights**. - 📱 **Simpler** and more **intuitive UI**. - 📆 **All four earth seasons** to check out! # FAQ ❓ > **Q:** Does Outerworlds support Multiplayer?: > > **A:** Yes, it does but with a few notes. For it to work, some mods have to be added to the server and all the players need to have the same mods and their respective versions. > **Q:** Will the modpack get updated to later Minecraft Updates?: > > **A:** Yes, it is planned to but it requires patience. Some mods that plays a big part of Outerworlds are not available for 26.0 or above, so I prefer to wait and ship the full package instead of uploading a half-baked one. > **Q:** Is there a way to report bugs or ask for help?: > > **A:** Yes, you can open an issue on GitHub or a ticket in Outerworld's Discord Server # Known Issues ❗ > **Issue:** JVM/Java Arguments warning when launching: > > **Solution:** In your launcher, find the profile settings, search for JVM/Java Arguments and paste this: > > "--add-modules jdk.incubator.vector" > **Issue:** Strong stutters when using the Spyglass: > > **Solution:** This is an issue caused by Voxy and it's unlikely to be fixed by now. In this case, don't move the camera too much when using the Spyglass
